subject: design-technology
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Sand casting is a process in which:
options: Molten metal is poured into a sand mould and left to solidify
A sheet of plastic is bent over a former
Material is removed by a rotating cutter
questions.explain: In sand casting, molten metal is poured into a cavity formed in sand and allowed to cool and solidify into shape.

questions.q: Brass is best described as:
options: A ferrous metal that rusts easily
An alloy of copper and zinc
questions.explain: Brass is an alloy made by combining copper and zinc, giving it good corrosion resistance and machinability.

questions.q: The main purpose of a capacitor in a basic circuit is to:
questions.explain: A capacitor stores electrical charge and can be used for timing, smoothing and energy-storage functions in circuits.

questions.q: 'Reduce' in the 6 Rs encourages designers and users to:
options: Use more material to be safe
Use less material and energy to make and run a product
questions.explain: Reduce focuses on minimising the amount of material and energy used in making and using a product.

questions.q: In an isometric drawing, vertical lines stay vertical and the other edges are drawn at:
questions.explain: Isometric drawings keep verticals upright and draw receding edges at 30 degrees to the horizontal to give a 3D impression.

questions.q: The unit used to measure electrical resistance is the:
questions.explain: Resistance is measured in ohms; voltage is measured in volts and current in amperes.

questions.q: Which property describes a material's ability to resist scratching, denting and wear?
questions.explain: Hardness is the ability of a material to resist abrasion, scratching and indentation.

questions.q: A driver pulley of 100 mm diameter drives a 50 mm pulley. The smaller pulley will turn:
options: At the same speed as the driver
questions.explain: A smaller driven pulley rotates faster than a larger driver pulley, increasing output speed.

questions.q: A resistor in a circuit is used to:
options: Limit or control the flow of current
questions.explain: A resistor opposes the flow of current, controlling how much current passes through a part of the circuit.

questions.q: Batch production is best defined as making:
options: A specified quantity of identical products in a group, then switching to another
A continuous non-stop flow of product 24 hours a day
questions.explain: Batch production makes a set number of identical items in one run, after which the equipment can be changed to produce a different batch.

questions.q: A diode is a component that allows current to flow:
questions.explain: A diode permits current to flow in one direction only, blocking it in the reverse direction.

questions.q: One key reason electronic systems are built into modern products is that they:
options: Remove the need for any materials
Allow products to sense, respond and be controlled automatically
Always make products cheaper to throw away
questions.explain: Electronics let products sense their surroundings and respond automatically, adding functions like automatic lighting or temperature control.

questions.q: A force that pulls or stretches a material is called:
questions.explain: Tension is a pulling or stretching force, while compression is a squashing force.

questions.q: Recycling differs from reusing because recycling:
options: Refuses to use the material at all
Processes a material to make a new product
Uses a product again in its current form
questions.explain: Recycling reprocesses a material into raw form to make a new product, whereas reusing keeps the original item in use as it is.

questions.q: What does CAM stand for in design and technology?
questions.explain: CAM stands for Computer-Aided Manufacture, where computer-controlled machines such as CNC routers make a product from a CAD file.

questions.q: A transistor in a circuit is most commonly used as:
questions.explain: A transistor can act as an electronic switch, turning an output on or off, or as an amplifier in a circuit.

questions.q: A bevel gear is mainly used to:
options: Transmit rotary motion through an angle, often 90 degrees
questions.explain: Bevel gears mesh at an angle, commonly 90 degrees, to change the direction of rotary drive.

questions.q: As light falling on an LDR increases, its resistance:
questions.explain: An LDR's resistance falls as light intensity rises, allowing more current to flow in bright conditions.

questions.q: Mechanical advantage is gained when a mechanism allows:
options: No load to be moved at all
A larger effort to move a smaller load
A small effort to move a larger load
Energy to be created from nothing
questions.explain: Mechanical advantage means a machine lets a small input effort overcome a larger output load.

questions.q: A wheelbarrow is an example of which class of lever?
questions.explain: In a wheelbarrow the load sits between the fulcrum (wheel) and the effort (handles), making it a second-class lever.

questions.q: A 'former' (mould) is used in vacuum forming to:
options: Provide the shape the softened plastic is pulled over
Cut the finished part to size
questions.explain: In vacuum forming a heated plastic sheet is sucked down over a former, which gives the part its shape.

questions.q: A design specification is best described as:
options: A list of the designer's hobbies
A list of measurable criteria the final product must meet
The advertising slogan for the product
questions.explain: A specification is a detailed list of criteria and requirements that the finished product must satisfy, used to guide and judge the design.
